name: Southwest Rapid Rewards Premier Business Credit Card

localized_names.en: Southwest Rapid Rewards Premier Business Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APRs; purchase APR 19.24% to 27.74%. Cash advance APR 28.49%. Default APR up to 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Terms page: Foreign - None.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 point per $1 spent on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeemed through the Rapid Rewards program for Southwest Airlines flights and other rewards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 points after you spend $3,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to 8 additional passengers in the same reservation can check their first bag at no additional cost. For a group of 4 this would be a savings of up to $360 roundtrip ($45 per bag per trip).

benefits.title: Complimentary Preferred Seat
benefits.description: Select a Standard or Preferred seat within 48 hours prior to departure, when available. For flights operating with assigned seating in 2026 and beyond.

benefits.title: Group 5 Boarding Benefit
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to 8 passengers in the same reservation will board with Group 5 giving them earlier access to overhead bins. For flights operating with assigned seating in 2026 and beyond.

benefits.title: 15% Flight Discount Each Year
benefits.description: Receive a 15% promo code each year on your cardmember anniversary (excludes basic fare).

benefits.title: 25% Back on Inflight Purchases
benefits.description: Receive 25% back on Southwest Airlines inflight purchases made with your Southwest Rapid Rewards Premier Business Credit Card.

benefits.title: 6,000 Anniversary Points Each Year
benefits.description: Receive 6,000 bonus points each year after your Cardmember anniversary.

benefits.title: Tier Qualifying Points Toward A-List Status
benefits.description: Earn 2,000 tier qualifying points (TQPs) toward A-List status for every $5,000 spent in purchases annually.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $10,000 per item.
